text:
ava-support: customer reports intermittent 403 from Google SSO at /auth/callback. Happens only when they open the login link from the mobile app webview. They can reproduce ~30% of attempts.

omar-eng: can you paste the exact redirect URL they saw?

ava-support: here's what customer pasted into the ticket: 
https://app.acme.com/auth/callback?code=4/0AAbCxyz&state=eyJzaWduX3Rva2VuIjoiYWJjMTIzJUMzJUEw8J+YgCIsInNpZCI6IjEyMyJ9&utm_medium=deep_link

jenna-se: thanks. quick question — is the state param encoded with emoji or spaces? mobile deeplink generator sometimes adds emojis, which can change percent-encoding.

ava-support: they said they use a deeplink lib that inserts a friendly slug with emoji. they supplied a failing example where state contains a smiley: %F0%9F%98%8A

omar-eng: looking at proxy logs for that customer — incoming request to our edge shows full querystring, but the forwarded request to auth-service sometimes lacks the state param:
```
GET /auth/callback?code=4/0AAbCxyz HTTP/1.1
Host: auth-service.internal
X-Forwarded-For: 10.0.2.5
```

jenna-se: that suggests the proxy might be normalizing or reserializing the querystring and dropping params with non-ASCII or certain encodings. which proxy are they behind?

ava-support: they go through our edge proxy + a customer CDP that rewrites tracking params. customer says CDP appends utm_ params.

omar-eng: repro attempt from curl against our proxy (simulating mobile UA):
```
curl -v 'https://edge.redwood.example/auth/callback?code=4/0AAbCxyz&state=%F0%9F%98%8A-slug&utm_source=cdp' -A 'Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android)' -H 'Host: app.acme.com'
```

omar-eng: when the proxy forwards the request the state sometimes becomes truncated or disappears entirely. Hypothesis: our querystring canonicalizer treats '+' and ' ' differently and also drops parameters longer than 200 bytes after normalization.

jenna-se: another angle — PKCE/code_verifier mismatch will also 403, but the logs show the oauth service returning "invalid_state" in a few traces. not PKCE.

mike-prod: deploy-bot shows oauth-service v1.12 rolled at 1767004350. any config changes to query parsing in that deploy?

omar-eng: no code change to oauth-service in v1.12, only a small tweak in logging. but edge-proxy was updated yesterday and includes a module that strips duplicate params and applies percent-decoding/recoding. rolling it back for a customer test might be fastest.

ava-support: customer on a call now and can test a rollback.

jenna-se: quick mitigation we can suggest to customer: if their deeplink generator can base64url-encode the state (no spaces/emojis) it should avoid this issue until infra patch. also include explicit state in fragment (not recommended) — but base64url is safe.

omar-eng: action items:
- infra: check edge-proxy query normalization rules and reproduce with emoji/non-ASCII state (assigned to omar-eng)
- prod: monitor 403s per deploy tag and correlate with edge version (assigned to mike-prod)
- support: advise customer to base64url-encode state and confirm test (assigned to ava-support)

deploy-bot: oauth-service v1.12 deployed at 1767004350 :white_check_mark:

ava-support: customer confirmed rollback of CDP rewrite fixed link for them. still pending a repro run on our side to be 100% certain.

omar-eng: I'll run a small reproducer across permutations (emoji, spaces, encoded vs raw) and post results. putting a short script here for others to run: 
```
#!/bin/bash
for s in "%F0%9F%98%8A-slug" "simple-slug" "a b" "a+b"; do
  curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{redirect_url}\n" \
    "https://edge.redwood.example/auth/callback?code=TEST&state=$s&utm_source=test" -A 'Mozilla/5.0 (Linux)'
done
```

jenna-se: if repro passes, we should add a guard in oauth-service to reject requests without state earlier and log the raw incoming querystring (pre-normalization) to help operators.

ava-support: thanks team — I'll update the support ticket and mark as escalated to infra.

mike-prod: logged incident INC-1767004 and added a short-term alert for spike in auth 403s tied to edge-proxy version.

ava-support: closing loop: customer switched to base64url-encoded state and reports no failures in 50 attempts. leaving open until infra confirms root cause.
